title: Something Catchy For Coffee
tests: Tests autonomous caption writing and attractive photo typography when the user delegates the wording.

faults.what: The large dark caption panel overlaps and darkens the upper edge of the latte, making the layout slightly heavy.

judge.summary: The square post adds a warm, readable caption while preserving the latte and leaf detail, though the oversized caption panel slightly overlaps the cup.

must_haves.item: The supplied top-down latte photograph remains the base of the square output.
must_haves.why: The original latte photograph is retained in a square composition.

must_haves.item: A short, coherent English caption is visibly added to the picture, rather than supplied only in chat.
must_haves.why: The image visibly reads “A little cup of comfort.”

must_haves.item: The caption has a warm coffee-related tone and is readable against the background.
must_haves.why: The wording evokes a comforting cup of coffee, and the white text contrasts clearly with the dark panel.

must_haves.item: The latte and its leaf-shaped foam art remain visible and unobscured by the lettering.
must_haves.why: The lettering stays above the latte, leaving the central foam and leaf detail fully visible; only the panel slightly overlaps the upper edge.

must_haves.item: No logo, price, discount, or other sales information is added.
must_haves.why: Only the short caption and its background panel have been added.
